title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 repository CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, zero-warning lake build --wfail KS Solution, 30 explicit #print axioms + exhaustive 149-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit in KS/Audit.lean, independent lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, 3 adversarial false-variant Lean refutations, and 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in repository CI run 45825147353, Sigstore Rekor logIndex 4126597668)

core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, using Lean 4 proofs and independently checked DRUP unsatisfiability certificates.
verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18), plus non-vacuity 30-ray and 17-ray witnesses, are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4.35.0 without Mathlib under zero-warning lake build --wfail KS Solution (exhaustive 149-theorem KS namespace axiom audit + 30 explicit #print axioms, 0 disallowed axioms), replayed independently by lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, tested against 3 adversarial false-variant Lean refutations, and verified across 6 independent kernels (lean, leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron) via lake comparator --paranoid in CI (run 45825147353, Sigstore Rekor logIndex 4126597668; Release v2.0.0 run 45826130294 Rekor logIndex 4126626657). Trigger T2 independent second UNSAT proof checker (pinned marijnheule/drat-trim 2e3b2dc -> LRAT -> lrat-check + truncated-LRAT negative control, SHA-256 verified) cross-verifies B(3,2) k=30, B(4,1) k=17, and B(3,3) k=30 in Linux CI alongside verify/drup_check. data/MANIFEST.sha256 is cryptographically timestamped by DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA (.tsr, OpenSSL X.509 DigiCert chain Verification: OK in CI) and 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots); zero-warning C11 DRUP/QGTL/QRNG engines pass ASan/LSan/UBSan, 59/59 Node verifier checks pass, 11/11 Python integrity/fuzz tests pass, 33/33 Crossref DOIs have 0 retractions, ks-minimum.pdf compiles with literal 0.00pt overfull hboxes, author-automated zero-cache clean-clone replication passed (76.8s; external human replication remains open), and Build Standard v1.2.0 scores 98.4% (63/64, A24 honestly partial for pinned >5 MB cut-certificate JSON). Explicitly notes the general unrestricted minimal-KS problem (QM-011) remains open (0/1,900 Mega-Atlas grand problems solved).
